# Copilot Proxy API

> Self-hosted proxy that exposes GitHub Copilot as an OpenAI-compatible,
> Anthropic-compatible, and Gemini-compatible API, so coding agents like Claude
> Code, Codex CLI, and Antigravity CLI (agy) can use a GitHub Copilot
> subscription as their model backend.

Unofficial, reverse-engineered, MIT-licensed. Not affiliated with GitHub. Runs
locally on port 4141 by default and requires an active Copilot subscription.

## What it does

- Serves `POST /v1/messages` (Anthropic Messages), used by Claude Code.
- Serves `POST /v1/responses` (OpenAI Responses), used by Codex CLI.
- Serves `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1beta/models`, `GET /v1/models/{id}`,
  `GET /v1beta/models/{id}`, `POST /v1/models/{id}:generateContent`,
  `POST /v1beta/models/{id}:generateContent`,
  `POST /v1/models/{id}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse`, and
  `POST /v1beta/models/{id}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse` (Gemini API), used by
  Antigravity CLI (`agy`).
- Serves `POST /v1/chat/completions` and `POST /v1/embeddings`.
- Translates Anthropic and Gemini requests to Copilot's format and back. The
  Responses route is a passthrough to Copilot's own Responses endpoint.

## Getting started with Claude Code

Run `npx copilot-proxy-api@latest start --claude-code`, complete GitHub device
sign-in, and select a primary and a small/fast model. The command prints a
launch command that sets `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4141/` and
`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` for Claude Code.

## Getting started with Codex CLI

Start the proxy with `npx copilot-proxy-api@latest start`, then add a custom
model provider to `~/.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
model = "gpt-5.5"
model_provider = "copilot_proxy"
model_reasoning_effort = "high"

[model_providers.copilot_proxy]
name = "GitHub Copilot via copilot-proxy-api"
base_url = "http://localhost:4141/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
```

`base_url` must end in `/v1` because Codex appends `/responses` itself. Setting
`OPENAI_BASE_URL` alone does not work on recent Codex versions. Pick a model id
that your plan advertises at `GET /v1/models`.

## Getting started with Antigravity CLI (agy)

Requires Antigravity CLI 1.5.12 or later. Start the proxy with
`npx copilot-proxy-api@latest start`, then launch `agy` against it:

```sh
GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4141 GEMINI_API_KEY=local-proxy \
  agy --settings '{"modelProvider":"gemini"}' --model gemini-4-neon --effort xhigh
```

For persistent setup, set `"modelProvider": "gemini"` in
`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json` and export `GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL`
and `GEMINI_API_KEY` in your shell profile. If the proxy runs with `--api-key`,
set `GEMINI_API_KEY` to that same key. Leave `/v1` and `/v1beta` off
`GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL` because `agy` appends `/v1beta/models/...` itself.

Supported Gemini features match Copilot's `/chat/completions` capabilities:
streaming SSE, non-streaming generation, function calling, parallel tool calls,
`thoughtSignature` round-trips, `thinkingLevel` (`MINIMAL` mapped to `low`,
`LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`, `XHIGH`), dynamic `thinkingBudget: -1`, inline images
(`image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`, `image/heic`, `image/heif`), and local
PDF text extraction (`application/pdf`). Requests for
`gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` fall back to `gemini-3.8-flash` when absent from
Copilot's catalog. Server-side Gemini tools (`googleSearch`, `urlContext`,
`codeExecution`) are rejected with HTTP 400.

## Desktop app (macOS)

Copilot Proxy Desktop (`desktop-v0.0.8`) is a native Rust (`iced`) menu bar app for Apple Silicon Macs that replaces Electron while reusing the local TypeScript proxy engine.

- Release page and SHA-256 checksums: https://github.com/voidsteed/copilot-proxy-api/releases/tag/desktop-v0.0.8
- Apple Silicon DMG: https://github.com/voidsteed/copilot-proxy-api/releases/download/desktop-v0.0.8/Copilot-Proxy-0.0.8-macos-arm64.dmg
- Apple Silicon ZIP: https://github.com/voidsteed/copilot-proxy-api/releases/download/desktop-v0.0.8/Copilot-Proxy-0.0.8-macos-arm64.zip
- Requires Node.js 24+ for the local proxy bridge. Because the release is ad-hoc signed, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Copilot Proxy.app"` before first launch.
- Provides copyable config snippets and duplicate-safe config merging for Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode, plus read-only diagnostics and session commands for Antigravity CLI (`agy`).
